why: The failure mode structured output cannot catch. A schema-valid, well-named, confidently-rationalised metric over a column that does not exist reads perfectly and breaks at compile time — the types are right and the grammar is right, so nothing upstream of dbt objects. This is the one template that is strictly better for being grounded: the allowlist is this project's real column list, so it catches a proposal reaching for the discount, tax or margin column that this mart happens not to have.
